title: IELTS Paket 4 — Behavioral Science, Heritage & Adaptation
theme: Spatial memory maps, museum acoustics, multi-metric summaries, and opinion essays.

passages.title: Wayfinding Without Screens: How Spatial Memory Strengthens
passages.body:
Paragraph A: Turn-by-turn satellite navigation trims wrong turns on unfamiliar highways, yet neuroscientists warn constant reliance leaves commuters with fragmented mental maps. In controlled maze and city-walk experiments, drivers following voice prompts recalled fewer side-street junctions afterward than peers navigating from brief landmark briefings.

Paragraph B: Dr. Priya Subramanian found hippocampal blood flow dropped measurably when GPS directions automated every turn, whereas manual route planning activated spatial grid cells tied to long-term orientation. Interestingly, glancing at a static overview map before departure preserved high spatial recall even when participants kept backup navigation silenced inside a pocket.

assets.caption: W: Welcome aboard! Normally volunteers check in at the Main Lobby, though painters are working there Saturday—please report to the West Wing Desk by 9:30 AM instead.

M: Did the laptop group outperform note-takers because they typed twice as many words? W: Actually the reverse—students writing brief margin summaries by hand scored higher on conceptual synthesis questions.

M: Because harsh chemical brushes can etch ancient marble carvings, museum conservators calibrate millisecond laser pulses that vaporize dark urban soot crusts instantly while leaving pale white stone untouched.

items.prompt: Listening Part 1 (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER): 'Museum Volunteer Orientation — Report to the ___ Desk by 9:30 AM.'
items.explanation: Pustakawan menyebut Main Lobby penuh renovasi sehingga orientasi pindah ke West Wing Desk.

items.prompt: Listening Part 3: What surprise did the psychology students discover in their attention-span pilot study?
options: Students taking handwritten margin notes recalled conceptual links better than laptop typists.
Laptop typists achieved higher scores on every conceptual question.
Silent rooms lowered reading speed by twenty percent.
Background alarms improved exam accuracy significantly.
items.answer: Students taking handwritten margin notes recalled conceptual links better than laptop typists.
acceptedAnswers: Students taking handwritten margin notes recalled conceptual links better than laptop typists.
items.explanation: Dialog menyoroti pencatat tangan lebih efektif menyarikan hubungan konsep dibanding pengetik verbatim di laptop.

items.prompt: Listening Part 4 (ONE WORD ONLY): 'Conservators use gentle laser pulses to lift dark ___ crusts off marble sculptures without scratching stone.'
items.explanation: Dosen menjelaskan pulsa laser mengangkat kerak jelaga ('soot') gelap tanpa menyentuh permukaan marmer.

items.prompt: Passage 1 ('Wayfinding Without Screens'): 'People following voice GPS directions remember more side-street intersections than landmark navigators.' -> TRUE, FALSE, or NOT GIVEN?
items.explanation: Paragraf A menyatakan pengemudi yang mengikuti GPS suara mengingat LEBIH SEDIKIT persimpangan jalan kecil ('recalled fewer side-street junctions').

items.prompt: Passage 1: 'Reviewing a static overview map prior to departure prevents spatial memory loss even with a backup phone nearby.' -> TRUE, FALSE, or NOT GIVEN?
items.explanation: Kalimat terakhir Paragraf B mengonfirmasi melihat peta ringkas statis sebelum berangkat mempertahankan daya ingat spasial walau membawa navigasi cadangan dalam saku.

items.prompt: Passage 1: 'Dr. Priya Subramanian recommends banning turn-by-turn navigation apps for commercial ambulance drivers.' -> TRUE, FALSE, or NOT GIVEN?
items.explanation: Teks membahas temuan aliran darah hipokampus, namun sama sekali tidak menyebut pengemudi ambulans atau usulan pelarangan aplikasi.

items.prompt: Summary Completion (ONE WORD ONLY from Passage 1): 'Manual route planning engages spatial ___ cells associated with long-term orientation.'
items.explanation: Paragraf B menyebut secara tepat 'activated spatial grid cells'.

items.prompt:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 1 (>=150 words, 20 min): The data below show the primary navigation methods used by adult travelers across three trip types in 2025 (%):
- Daily Work Commute: GPS App 62%, Memory/Landmarks 34%, Paper Map 4%
- Domestic Weekend Trip: GPS App 78%, Memory/Landmarks 15%, Paper Map 7%
- Hiking Trail Navigation: GPS App 44%, Memory/Landmarks 22%, Paper Map 34%
Summarize and compare the main patterns.
items.explanation: Sorot dominasi GPS di perjalanan akhir pekan/komuter kontras dengan porsi peta kertas yang masih tinggi (34%) pada jalur pendakian.

items.prompt: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 (>=250 words, 40 min): Public museums increasingly spend major budgets on interactive touchscreen displays rather than traditional labeled artifact cabinets. Do the advantages of high-tech museum displays outweigh the disadvantages?
items.explanation: Evaluasi kedua sisi (keterlibatan pengunjung vs biaya pemeliharaan/gangguan fokus pada artefak asli) lalu nyatakan apakah keunggulannya lebih besar.

items.prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 1 (~30–45s): 'Are you good at remembering directions in a new town without checking your phone? How do you usually find your way?'
items.explanation: Jawab santai dalam 3–4 kalimat dengan menyebut penanda visual (landmarks) atau peta.

items.prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 Cue Card (1 min prep · 2 min speak): Describe a museum, exhibition, or historical landmark that taught you something memorable.
You should say:
- where it was
- what you saw there
- how information was presented
- and explain why the visit stayed in your memory.
items.explanation: Bangun alur cerita dari kedatangan -> pameran paling berkesan -> pelajaran/insight yang terbawa hingga kini.

items.prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 3 (~60s): 'Should city governments preserve free entry to national museums even when budgets tighten, or charge visitors to fund conservation?'
items.explanation: Bahas akses pendidikan setara bagi masyarakat vs model tiket bertingkat (gratis bagi pelajar/warga lokal, tiket bagi turis).
